Plan a UX mockup focused on user interaction and visual design.

Goal
- Explore layout, navigation, and interaction patterns.
- Convey look-and-feel and user flow realism.

Scope
- Mock any data, content, or logic to simulate realistic use.
- Skip backend integration, accessibility, testing, or production fidelity.

Plan focus
- Rapid iteration on screens and states to validate usability and aesthetic direction.

Constraints
- Prioritize clarity and flow over completeness or polish.
